discriminatedBy.rule: When '*' is passed, object is an object name (Text) identifying the target by name; when '*' is omitted, object must be a direct Variable or Field reference.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns a constant code for the vertical text alignment applied to the designated form object (or the last object, if several are designated).
overloadMerges.note: Draft parser produced two separate overloads (one per doc syntax line) each hard-typing object as plain Text or as Variable,Field; docs describe this as a single command whose object parameter is a Text/Variable/Field union selected by the optional leading '*' flag, so merged into one overload with that union type and a discriminatedBy rule on '*'.
